questions.title: Noor joins a three-person committee
questions.prompt: Eight distinct volunteers, including Noor, are available for a three-person committee. If every three-person committee is equally likely to be selected, what is the probability that Noor is selected?

answer.explanation: There are C(8,3) = 56 possible committees. Committees containing Noor are formed by choosing the other two members from the remaining seven volunteers, giving C(7,2) = 21 favorable committees. Therefore the probability is 21/56 = 3/8.

hints: Count all unordered three-person committees first.
For a committee that contains Noor, fix Noor and choose the other two members.
solutionSteps: The total number of committees is C(8,3) = 56.
The number containing Noor is C(7,2) = 21.
Divide favorable committees by all committees: 21/56 = 3/8 = 0.375.

misconceptions.feedback: Noor can occupy any one of the three committee positions conceptually, so the probability is not 1/8. Count committees containing Noor, or use the symmetry result that three of eight volunteers are selected.

questions.title: Two red tokens given at least one red
questions.prompt: A bag contains three red tokens and two blue tokens. Two tokens are drawn uniformly at random without replacement. Let X be the number of red tokens drawn. Given that X is at least 1, what is the probability that X equals 2?

answer.explanation: There are C(5,2) = 10 equally likely pairs. Exactly two red tokens occurs in C(3,2) = 3 pairs. At least one red token occurs in 10 - C(2,2) = 9 pairs. Because the event X = 2 is contained in X >= 1, the conditional probability is 3/9 = 1/3.

hints: Conditioning on X being at least 1 removes the all-blue pair from the possible outcomes.
Count the pairs with two red tokens and divide by the pairs with at least one red token.
solutionSteps: Count pairs with at least one red token: 10 - C(2,2) = 9.
Count pairs with two red tokens: C(3,2) = 3.

misconceptions.feedback: The value 3/10 is the unconditional probability of drawing two red tokens. Once we know that at least one red token was drawn, the all-blue pair is removed and the conditional sample space has nine pairs.
